sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Break the Deal is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Yo, you doing good? You will never believe what I'm going to tell you right now. I have a job for you! Alright, jokes aside, the Reshala guy wants to jump head first into a new business. And believe me, I don't want this fucker in there. I found out this punk's planning a meeting with one of my partners with ties to the big land. Thing is, we only know the meeting spot, but we don't know when they're gonna sort their shit out. So I hired a trustworthy sniper to crash the meeting when it happens. Except that now he's in his position out there all the fucking time, can't even go down to take a piss. What's more, the stash I set up for him at the lookout spot was found by the Scavs, and they looted everything clean. You think you can drop off the rest of the gear? It's at the plant with three large pipes in the middle of the industrial zone. It's got some metal scaffolding or something around it... Hide it all over that scaffolding, alright? Shit, man, of fucking course I'll pay you for it. Work hard, and you'll earn hard, hehe."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Stash a DVL-10 sniper rifle at the specified spot on Customs
- Stash a DVL-10 magazine at the specified spot on Customs
- Stash an ELCAN SpecterDR scope at the specified spot on Customs
- Stash a pack of any 7.62x51 ammo at the specified spot on Customs

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +11,400 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.03
- 105,000 Roubles
  - 110,250 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
  - 120,750 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
- 1× IOTV Gen4 body armor (High Mobility Kit, MultiCam)
"So, you seen my gunslinger? Of course not, he's a real specialist! Now, my guys will give him the signal, and he'll pick up everything from the designated points. Here, a little thank you for the hard work."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Lobaev Arms DVL-10 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle | 1 | Required | N/A | Placed item |
| DVL-10 7.62x51 10-round magazine | 1 | Required | N/A | Placed item |
| ELCAN SpecterDR 1x/4x scope | 1 | Required | N/A | Placed item |
| Any 7.62x51mm NATO ammo pack | 1 | Required | N/A | Placed item |

In this quest you have to stash the 4 specified items on the scaffolding of the industrial plant on Customs. After accepting the quest you will be sent a set of the required items via in-game mail. It is possible to completely disassemble the DVL-10 rifle since it doesn't need to be functional to be stashed.

Note: If you have a DVL-10 equipped as primary or secondary weapon, it will be used up as first for the stashing.
